_note: Extra details the RSS feed doesn't carry, keyed by each episode's guid from the feed. category is one of: business, law, risk, other. youtubeId is the part after watch?v= in the episode's YouTube link; it sets the Watch link and the thumbnail. Optional for the episode page: notesHeading (a line above the show notes; \n breaks the line), chapters (a list of {"start": "06:42", "title": "..."}), and slug (to override the URL, which defaults to the title). Episodes not listed here still appear, just without these.
